description: Proposed upgrading of Old Windsor Road : Seven Hills Road to Windsor Road : review of environmental factors is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The initial concept was to upgrade Old Windsor Road to four lanes along its existing alignment. However, following a preliminary environmental assessment undertaken in 1992, the road and surrounding elements were concluded to be items of National heritage significance which required conservation.
